patch_description: Replace the fixed central CZ with a trainable CRZ and use the empirically stronger post-entanglement RY basis. Removing the post-RY on qubit 3 offsets the new controlled-rotation parameter, keeping 24 parameters per block and 146 overall. The near-identity initialized CRZ provides selective, data-adaptive coupling across the chain’s central partition, while the reduced gate count and retained parameter budget should improve optimization speed and generalization.
